notes.title: Message From RS Games.
notes.notes:
Hello
My name is Lee Hae-sung, CEO of RS Games.
First of all, I apologize to you as the CEO for not being able to proceed with the launch schedule.

First of all, we were originally preparing to launch the project rayssus in early March.
Then, there was a sudden contact with an overseas company, and for this purpose, two employees including me
Due to the urgent business trip, the schedule was adjusted to March 12th, but the overseas schedule was additionally set until the 13th
As it increased, the second adjustment was made to March 17th.

This is a schedule adjustment based on my judgment, and I'm not updating the notice and added in additional comments
As the person in charge, I apologize for any part that was not properly communicated to those who are watching the announcement.

After that, we completed our overseas schedule and returned to Korea on March 17 and held a crunch schedule from March 14th to 16th for release
I was preparing to give you a notice at 1 p.m. after the final inspection at 9 a.m. on the 17th. At 11:24 a.m. on the 17th, at the city hall where our office is located
Suddenly, business suspension and fines were issued, and the reason for the disposition was that the room used as an office was inappropriate for use.

Prior to this, we have experienced various problems due to continuous false complaints from unknown people
We recently moved our office to another place in the same location.

Even though we formed a business in 2020 and the office is not operating properly due to the COVID-19 situation until 2021
We were preparing for the release schedule as we progressed the development, but as the COVID-19 began to die down, an unknown number of people
Complaints continued to occur, and we continued to respond to them, causing unnecessary consumption

In 2023, one person eventually came to the office, damaged server equipment, and assaulted me.

Below is the civil complaint department and information we have received since 2021.

July 21, 2021: I don't think it's for actual use after reporting to the business place: National Tax Service

August 13, 2021: The company is reported as a game production business, but it seems to be operating in relation to gambling: The district office is located

November 21, 2021: The company seems to have reported no income even though it has income: National Tax Service

January 27, 2022: It is reported as a game production business, but it is presumed to be used for other purposes: Watch the location

March-August 2022: Like a defective company that makes false reports and operates: continuous complaints from the city hall and the district office

January to March 2023: Estimated to be using illegal electricity in the building where the company is moving in: KEPCO where it is located

July-September 2023: Estimated that the company will mine virtual currency after reporting it as a game production business: Watch location

April-September 2024: Estimated that the company reports the production of game software and produces arcade games: Gu office where it is located

With a number of such false complaints and continuous filing, we continue to submit explanatory materials to the city hall and the district office
It's hard to say that it's normal after being dismissed after being found to be false, but it consumes the operation of the company
I've been keeping it. I've recently changed my office location with him, so I've stopped filing complaints
We also prepared again and announced the release.

However, not long after the announcement of the launch, suddenly, the use of the office is suitable for the un-purpose, we received a complaint that it has not been changed, and accordingly, we will suspend business for 5 days and dispose of it due to negligence. It is a situation where we have to proceed with the repurposing of the office.

When we moved to the current office, we were informed by real estate companies and building owners that there was no problem with the operation of the office
Until now, the district office had completed game production and business registration without raising any problems
Not long after the announcement of the launch, a complaint occurred when it was being used without any problems
As a result, there is another problem with our operating schedule, so we need to understand the situation internally
I couldn't give you a notice quickly because it was first.

Currently, the purpose of the office is education facilities and academy facilities, and not only our office but also in the same building
Other companies had this purpose, but they were approved and using it without any problems.
In such a situation, we filed a complaint only targeting us and received this action, so we have previously
It is judged to be the same person or group who received complaints by unspecified personnel

In accordance with the regulations on the protection of personal information and the protection of civil petitioners, no information of the person or group concerned is received
We can't even get it. So, the remaining options for us are as soon as we release it without prior announcement
I think the only way is to announce it right away

[b]We would like to inform you of the contents through an announcement immediately after the launch without prior announcement of the launch. [/b]

Lastly, because of this incident, we're back to being liars
Nevertheless, I haven't given up on playing games and I'm still working hard to refine it by working from home.

Also, we are in the process of repurposing the office and are currently in the process of changing the use of the office
Additional tax and legal costs to completely block the factors themselves to ensure that all issues are addressed
We are proceeding to review and remove it.

if we were not a large company or a mid-sized company with some experience. As an indie developer that started with four like-minded people, it was about to take a step forward
It was too hard to handle all these things. To be honest, in the middle
It was a situation where I even had a fear that if I played a game like this, I might get more bad situation.

Still, it's too bad to give up on what I've been working on and throw it away
Nevertheless, we are holding out because there are people who have been supporting and waiting for us.

If we don't release it while benefiting from this game, it's natural to be criticized and treated like a fraud.

But I've never had investment or support anywhere in my nearly five years of just pouring my own money into it.
In the first place, there is no place to invest in or support non-mainstream mechanical games for new indie developers.

There was Tumblebuck Funding, which was conducted once on its own, but in fact, the cost of funding was
The production of sponsored items alone ran out and even exceeded that, resulting in additional company spending.

Nevertheless, the reason I don't give up is because I think I give up the results of someone's efforts as intended.

Finally, I had a lot of worries about writing this content.
To be honest, it's a company problem and it's not something that users should know, and there's no reason to know
It doesn't matter if you find out.

Some people point out why it takes so long to release a game and why is it playing every time.
You're right. It was a project we started without thinking that it would be this bad.

We saw all the comments you posted on the previous notice in real time. Of course, it was a situation that everyone would be happy about
I'm so sorry, but I know that you've been interested in our game, so I'm back with such comments.
Therefore, it's an internal matter, but I thought I had to convey the situation like this.

We will proceed with the launch as soon as possible and notify you.
If possible, we would like to proceed with the launch even during the weekend, but please understand that we cannot give you a definite answer at this time.

I will do my best to release the game at least before the end of March

Once again, thank you to those who waited and apologize for the delay in the schedule.

notes.title: sorry for the delay in announcing the schedule.
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Project Racers development team.

First of all, I'm sorry that I couldn't suddenly update the notice for a long time.
Currently, the release schedule is being delayed for a considerable amount of time due to various complicated situations internally.
We should have delivered it as soon as possible, but the notice was delayed for a considerable period of time because we had to prioritize problem solving.

The reasons why the release schedule does not proceed are summarized in three briefly below.

1. Deterioration of buildings in the offices we are currently renting, mass leakage due to recent heavy rains, and abnormal operation of electrical facilities
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608495/2a2c5182f7c57c03cc8768dabf2a63ae5bd0a48c.jpg[/img]
*This leak is currently occurring throughout the office.
2. Claiming more than insurance costs and management expenses for repairs and damages of the relevant building management office
3. Demand for the sudden disappearance of the lessee of the office under lease and the sale and eviction before the expiration of the lease through the auction of the leased office.

As a result, at this point, we urgently evicted and stored office equipment first, and the management office and
We are in the process of requesting rights guarantees, related recovery, and damage compensation against tenants.

In addition, even the deposit has not yet been returned despite the need to rent a new office, and without notification to us
The current system as the auction sale is carried out, overlapping the adjustment process for a number of additional issues and lease periods
We are facing a situation where it is difficult to proceed with the scheduled game schedule.

Therefore, we are currently thinking of the following three possible alternatives.

1. Resume release schedule after completing new office lease and equipment transfer.
-There is no additional development period, but the expected delay due to office rental and relocation is at least two months.

2. Once the online function is removed, the online function is added at the time when the office relocation is completed after pre-launching in offline mode.
-Additional development period for change and redesign to offline mode occurs and requires about a month
Most of the systems designed with the assumption of online functionality are separated, rebuilt, and destabilized.

3. After external hosting or renting a server to launch, transfer servers and data to existing equipment after completion of office relocation.
-Although the launch schedule has the smallest delay range, the burden of expenditure is very high and the response speed is slow when problems such as service instability are caused.

In the above situation, several complex problems overlapped, so the update of the notice was delayed as we focused on solving the problem.

We will decide on an alternative plan as soon as possible and deliver it to you with additional notice.

Also, if you leave your opinion on the alternative plan in the comments of the notice, we will refer to the decision.

Once again, we are very sorry for the delay in delivering the contents, and we will deliver additional contents as soon as possible.

notes.notes:
Hello, we are RS Games.

Project Rayssus Early Access service will begin on June 19, 2024.

Before launching the service, we will introduce you to the detailed service schedule and related content.

1. Service Launch Schedule

[strike]- Client Download: June 19, 2024 at 6:00 am (KST)
- Server opening and service commencement: June 19, 2024 at 8:30 a.m. (KST)
[/strike]

- Client Download: June 19, 2024 at 11:00 pm (KST)
- Server opening and service commencement: June 20, 2024 at 00:00 a.m. (KST)

[strike]*The final inspection and optimization of the server have been delayed, so there are some changes in the schedule. We ask for your understanding

! Additional announcement at 5:10 AM, Jun 19, 2024!
During the final inspection of the server, some of the information transmission between players during multiplayer is
We have identified missing or lost issues. Corrections and recovery procedures for issues have been entered
I needed a little more time, so I inevitably adjusted the time to the afternoon.[/strike]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Additional delay reason guidance[/b]

Although the issue of missing or losing transmission details between players was corrected and inspected
There is no problem with our system, so during the detailed inspection, has been identified as a problem with the network line itself and is currently in the process of replacing the network we use it for the server.

As network replacement is carried out through telecommunication companies, not us, line replacement and network reconstruction are carried out
It has become a necessary situation and inevitably needs more time.

The line we use for the server is SK Broadband corporate line
The reason for the replacement of the line is the old line of the internal network of the building connected to our office
Data loss and delay due to some corruption or setup errors.

If the work is completed earlier than the scheduled time, we will notify you immediately and proceed with the release.

Please understand this.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2. Service Content and System Guide

- A new server, 'GramAce' and 'Aerostinger' will be opened.

- Cross-platform functionality is supported.
* The account you purchased and played on Steam can also be linked to Project Racers on other platforms.

- 6 Playable Rayssus will be rolled out.

[Lightweight Rayssus]: Aerostinger, Stingray
[Standard Rayssus]: Gram-Ace, Helios, White Illusion
[Heavyweight Rayssus] : Still Guardian

-Playable armament will be rolled out.
[Main weapon - Assualt Rifle]: Helio striker, energy spitter
[Main weapon - Long Range Rifle] : Revolve Chaser, Plasma Precher
[Main weapon - Shotgun]: Helio Stayner, energy shocker

[Secondary weapon - Energy blaster] : Plasma radian, energy cast
[Secondary weapon - Missile launcher] : Quad Tamer, burst carrier
[Secondary weapon - Bazooka] : Slinger shot, Storm Bringer

[Melee weapon - Blade] : Static edge, particle slicer
[Melee Weapon - Spear] : Static Pierce. Spread Edge
[Melee weapon - Scythe] : Static slicer, DeathScythe

[Defensive Weapon - Shield]: Gram Defender, Aero Dispenser, Helio Reflector

- The following game modes will be opened.

[One-man play - Arena mode]
PVE mode for a one-on-one battle against the AI Racers.
Arena rank rises with Arena points earned by play.
The higher the Arena rank, the more open the battle against the stronger Racers

*At this point, the open rank is Frank level 8, and the maximum liftable rank is also up to Frank level 8.

[1 player play - Standard mode]
As a normal PVE mode, we remove UIE from various conditions and maps and earn rewards as we achieve our mission goals.
This mission can be repeated continuously.

*Arrive point: The mission is to remove the UIE and arrive at the designated target location within the limited time.
*Wave Stand: The mission is to endure by removing UIE that has been attacking periodically for a limited time.
*Tower Defense: A mission to defend the energy tower by preventing UIE that has been attacking periodically for a limited time.
*Clean Area: Mission to remove all UIEs that exist within the area for a limited time.

[Online Play - PVE Mode]
It is a mode in which missions in the standard mode can be cleared in cooperation with other users or friends through online matching.

*At this point, there are two modes supported: Wavestand and Tower Defense.

[Online Play - PVP Mode]
It's a mode where players can play against each other through online matching

*Deathmatch: A mission to shoot down the racers of all players other than yourself as much as possible for a limited time to earn the highest points.

*Team Death Match: This is a mission to shoot down the opponent's Racers as much as possible with your team members, including yourself, and the team that scores a high point wins.

- Interface functions
The rollover tooltip function is enabled.
When you mouse over a question mark icon on a numerical value or UI, it displays the details of that content.

The store function will be activated.
With the credits earned from Mission Play, you can buy or resell the parts, weapons, and skills you need in the store.

The hangar function is activated.
Combine the parts you have in the hangar, combine your own racers, and save them as a preset.

The user information function is activated.
You can check and set play history, weapon proficiency, and performance numerical stat.

*Activation functions may vary depending on the pre-launch server environment and whether it is optimized.

It's just around the corner. We'll do our best to wrap it up until the launch goes well.
